feature_provenance.polypharmacy_flag: binary(total_med_count>=5) from admission orders — known at admission; NOT a set difference result
feature_provenance.high_alert_flag: any high-alert medication in pre+admission scan — known at admission
feature_provenance.high_alert_count: count of high-alert medications — known at admission
feature_provenance.prior_encounter_count: count of prior hospital encounters before this admission

exclusion_rationale.discontinued_medication_count: OMISSION label logic: count(PAML - AML) == OMISSION candidate count
exclusion_rationale.total_medication_count: union size: |PAML union AML| — drives polypharmacy_flag indirectly but too correlated with label directly
exclusion_rationale.pre_admission_medication_count: PAML size — directly used in OMISSION detection
exclusion_rationale.admission_medication_count: AML size — directly used in OMISSION/DUPLICATION detection
exclusion_rationale.potential_duplicate_candidates: DUPLICATION label logic: count(codes with freq>=2 in AML)

note: Model may only receive features listed in safe_features. Any forbidden_feature in input triggers inference failure.
